title: Pather Panchali (film)
summary: Satyajit Ray's first film, a portrait of an impoverished Brahmin family in rural Bengal seen through their young son Apu, premiered at the Museum of Modern Art in New York on 3 May 1955, without subtitles. It won acclaim at international festivals including Cannes and is the first film of the Apu Trilogy, which was later restored after damage to its negatives.
